Source_Of_Input: x_GL^n from load; x_GL^(n+1) from flotation remapping (Step 7b of master algorithm)

Mathematical_Expression: lambda_g^(n+1) = (x_GL^(n+1) - i_g * Delta_x) / Delta_x  with lambda_g^(n+1) > lambda_g^n; lambda_g^(n+1) < 1
Source_Of_Input: x_GL^(n+1) from flotation remapping; i_g unchanged
Mass_Conservation_Check: lambda_g increases; cell pointer g unchanged
Notes: Sub-cell linear interpolation. Fraction clipped to [0

Mathematical_Expression: Source = floating ice at cell g (the same terminal cell; the newly grounded sub-volume was floating ice at this location in the previous step)  H_source = H_{g}^n from BedMachine V4.1 or floating-ledger state at t_n
Source_Of_Input: H_g^n from BedMachine V4.1 or floating-ledger record
Mass_Conservation_Check: REQUIRED: source must be explicitly defined — ice is NOT created from vacuum
Notes: The floating reservoir holds mass from previous advance/retreat cycles. BedMachine V4.1 provides the initial floating thickness for cells that have not yet been touched by the floating ledger.

Operation: Compute newly grounded volume and mass
Mathematical_Expression: Delta_Vol_ground = W_g * H_source * (lambda_g^(n+1) - lambda_g^n) * Delta_x  Delta_M_ground = rho_i * Delta_Vol_ground
Source_Of_Input: H_source from A3; lambda values; W_g
Mass_Conservation_Check: Mass removed from floating; added to grounded
Notes: Ice reclassified from floating to grounded — total cryosphere mass unchanged.

Mass_Conservation_Check: Floating decreases; grounded increases by same amount
Notes: Bilateral check: M_gr(t_{n+1}) - M_gr(t_n) = +Delta_M_ground (from advance); floating side loses Delta_M_ground.

Mathematical_Expression: g(n+1) = g(n)  (pointer unchanged — same terminal cell; fraction increased)
Notes: Pointer stable; partial-cell fraction drives grounded volume.

Mathematical_Expression: lambda_g^(n+1) >= 1  (grounding line has crossed the full downstream edge of the current terminal cell)
Notes: CFL restriction must prevent > 1 full-cell advance per step.

Operation: Complete grounding of current terminal cell
Mathematical_Expression: Delta_Vol_term = W_g * H_source_g * (1 - lambda_g^n) * Delta_x  (volume of the remaining floating portion of the current terminal cell that is now grounded)  Delta_M_term = rho_i * Delta_Vol_term  Floating_ledger -= Delta_M_term
Source_Of_Input: H_source_g at current terminal cell; lambda values; W_g
Mass_Conservation_Check: Mass transferred from floating to grounded for current terminal cell
Notes: Current terminal cell now fully grounded (lambda=1).

Operation: Identify source for newly exposed cell (g+1)
Mathematical_Expression: New candidate cell g+1: H_{g+1}^n is from BedMachine V4.1 (initial floating thickness) or from floating ledger if the cell has been visited before.  Flotation test: if H_{g+1}^(n+1,*) > H_crit_{g+1} then cell g+1 is grounded.
Source_Of_Input: BedMachine V4.1 floating thickness or floating-ledger record
Mass_Conservation_Check: REQUIRED: source reservoir for cell g+1 must be explicitly defined
Notes: If BedMachine data is not available for cell g+1 (e.g. glacier terminus is beyond domain): use H_{g+1} = 0 (no ice advance beyond data extent) and flag RSK_DATA_02.

Operation: Compute newly grounded mass for cell g+1
Mathematical_Expression: lambda_{g+1}^(n+1) = (x_GL^(n+1) - (i_g+1)*Delta_x) / Delta_x  (clipped to [0,1])  Delta_Vol_new = W_{g+1} * H_{g+1}^n * lambda_{g+1}^(n+1) * Delta_x  Delta_M_new = rho_i * Delta_Vol_new  Floating_ledger -= Delta_M_new
Source_Of_Input: H_{g+1}^n from BedMachine or floating ledger; lambda_{g+1}^(n+1); W_{g+1}
Mass_Conservation_Check: Mass removed from floating reservoir and added to grounded ledger
Notes: CFL restriction ensures lambda_{g+1}^(n+1) <= 1 (at most one new full cell per step).

Mathematical_Expression: g(n+1) = g(n) + 1  New terminal cell: g+1  New partial fraction: lambda_g^(n+1) = lambda_{g+1}^(n+1) from A10
Source_Of_Input: g(n) from load; advance trigger from A7
Notes: Pointer incremented by exactly 1. CFL restriction ensures this.

Mathematical_Expression: M_gr(t_{n+1}) + Floating_ledger(t_{n+1}) = M_gr(t_n) + Floating_ledger(t_n) + Delta_t * Mdot_SMB^n - Delta_t * rho_i * Q_calving^n
Source_Of_Input: All ledger values; SMB; calving flux
Mass_Conservation_Check: Bilateral ledger conservation — must hold to machine precision
Notes: Identical check as retreat (R10). Both retreat and advance must satisfy the same bilateral identity.

Operation: Raise error flag if multi-cell advance occurs
Mathematical_Expression: If g(n+1) - g(n) > 1: raise RSK_NUM_08; halve Delta_t; redo timestep
Mass_Conservation_Check: Safety check — CFL restriction should prevent this
Notes: CFL restriction: Delta_t <= Delta_x / |v_GL|_max must be verified before each timestep.
